adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired doi__10.3389_fchem.2017.00001 by extracting all local Table 2 MIC and Table 3 cytotoxicity threshold rows, preserving non-normalized/mixed database conflicts, and bounding mechanism claims to structure-activity inference. The paper is publication-grade with cautions, not clean acceptance.

caution_findings.note: Some database sequences omit or abstract D-Arg, N-methyl Arg, Chex, or terminal amidation; these are not promoted to exact source_verified.
Rows containing targets from other publication contexts are preserved as conflicts; only this DOI-supported Table 2/3 assertions are linked to primary evidence.
Local .bin assets are HTML landing/article/redirect pages, so no supplementary table value was fabricated.
The current paper supports structure-activity inference only; direct membrane/ribosome/DnaK mechanism claims remain out of scope.
